title: EV Yields
description: Complete list of EV yields for all Pokémon in Pokémon Polished Crystal
html:
Introduction

Effort Values (EVs) are gained by defeating or catching Pokémon. Each Pokémon yields specific EVs when defeated. These EVs contribute to the growth of a Pokémon's stats, allowing for customized training and optimization!

This guide provides a comprehensive list of EV yields for all Pokémon in Polished Crystal that you can use to search for training purposes.

If you would like to learn more about EVs, check out our IVs & EVs guide!
